title: Planet Mars
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 13 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Mars as effort, the navel and friendship: forgiveness, Mangalik, debt, the coral rules, will power and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 13, Planet Mars by Brajesh Gautam: purushartha, the navel, friendship, Mangalik, debt, remedies and Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Trust your own arrows. Do not hang your hope on results or on other people.
Fire, digestion, will power. A frightened navel means illness and anger.
Forgive, say forget it, make friends. Your spouse should be your friend.
Mars sits between Jupiter and Venus.
The Mangalik fuss is about the husband and wife pair.
You are the instrument. Then Mars stays set.
Do not fear it, do not gamble on it, do not lend twice.
His coral rules are recorded, not endorsed. Ivory is banned.
puts: <h3>Mars the driver, between husband and wife
